plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cisco routers running IOS-XR (ASR 9000, NCS, CRS, XRv). Besides standard IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects CPU utilization (CISCO-PROCESS-MIB), memory pools (CISCO-ENHANCED-MEMPOOL-MIB, 64-bit counters preferred) and power-supply / fan-tray operational state (CISCO-ENTITY-FRU-CONTROL-MIB, names from ENTITY-MIB).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of each IOS-XR processor as a 0-100 percentage from CISCO-PROCESS-MIB cpmCPUTotal5minRev. Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Bytes in use in each IOS-XR memory pool from CISCO-ENHANCED-MEMPOOL-MIB. 64-bit cempMemPoolHCUsed is preferred; cempMemPoolUsed is used when the HC pair is absent or both counters are 0. Invalid pools are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free bytes in each IOS-XR memory pool from CISCO-ENHANCED-MEMPOOL-MIB. 64-bit cempMemPoolHCFree is preferred; cempMemPoolFree is used when the HC pair is absent or both counters are 0.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of each IOS-XR pool as used / (used + free) × 100, rounded to 0.01 percent at collection. Pools with used + free = 0 or valid ≠ true are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each IOS-XR fan tray from CISCO-ENTITY-FRU-CONTROL-MIB cefcFanTrayOperStatus, normalised to 1=normal (up) / 2=abnormal (down or warning) / 3=unknown (unknown). Empty slots and rows without a status are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each IOS-XR power supply from CISCO-ENTITY-FRU-CONTROL-MIB cefcFRUPowerOperStatus on ENTITY-MIB powerSupply entities, normalised to 1=normal (on) / 2=abnormal (offEnvOther, offAdmin, failed and the other defined PowerOperType values except on). PowerOperType has no unknown enumerator; a literal unknown reading maps to 3. Empty slots and non-powerSupply FRUs are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
